issues.description: Version-level manifest.yaml uses field 'software' instead of 'name' as specified in code-style rule 14 template (name: zlib). The software-level manifest.yaml also uses 'software'. This appears to be a consistent project convention but deviates from the documented template.
issues.recommendation: Consider aligning field name to 'name' per code-style template, or update the code-style rule to document 'software' as an acceptable alias.

issues.description: commands.json is a newly created file (confirmed via git: not present in main branch, 12 insertions 0 deletions). It only includes version 1.0.20260223, but a previous version 1.0.20250521 exists (visible in README.md version table and in directory archives/w/wireguard-tools/1.0.20250521/). R38 requires the file to exist for tool packages — this is satisfied. However, for completeness and consistency, the previous version entry should also be included in the 'versions' map.
issues.recommendation: Add entry for 1.0.20250521: "1.0.20250521": { "ref": "wireguard-tools/1.0.20250521", "binary": false } to the versions map.

issues.description: Version-level manifest.yaml has both top-level 'build_system: makefile' (line 5) and nested 'build.system: makefile' (line 15) which is redundant. Minor structural inconsistency.
issues.recommendation: Remove the nested 'build.system' field or consolidate into one location.

summary: Audit PASSED for wireguard-tools 1.0.20260223.
